public_rationale: Contemporary survey reporting supports the narrower statement that creators were reporting lost work. OpenAI also had licensing partnerships. Neither finding establishes what proportion of creators represented in its training data received payment. The compound claim therefore remains unresolved; partial support and missing evidence do not justify mixed.
limitations: The original survey page could not be read, so employment evidence comes from contemporary reporting.
The compensation population and payment basis are not disclosed.
Reported displacement is not a causal estimate of OpenAI's effect.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI does not pay most creators for training materials, and many creators are losing gigs.

statement.excerpt: But wait, if he really believes in basic income for all, why is he fleecing artists, writers, and other creators, not paying a nickel (to most) for training materials? A lot of them are losing gigs.

from_speaker: not paying a nickel (to most) for training materials
A lot of them are losing gigs
our_interpretation: Most means more than half of the creators whose material OpenAI used for training, counted by creator rather than by number of works.
Compensation includes payments passed through a publisher or other intermediary when they reach the creator.
A lot means substantial documented instances of lost commissions or assignments, without requiring a majority of creators to have lost work.
The latest observable period is early 2024 through the post date. This is an ongoing-state observation, not a claim about subsequent employment.
The two clauses do not establish that OpenAI itself caused every reported loss of work. The word fleecing is evaluative and is not separately scored.
The financial scope below covers the compensation clause; the employment clause concerns lost assignments.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes that more than half of the relevant creators received no training compensation and that substantial numbers of creators were already losing assignments.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes that at least half of the relevant creators received compensation, or sufficiently comprehensive employment evidence contradicts substantial losses of assignments.
